t: Robust Forge Steel jab saw designed for efficient and precise cutting work on various materials. Ideal for trade professionals needing reliable performance on site, it effectively cuts wood, plasterboard, and PVC, and is also suitable for drywall installations. This 5.9" (150mm) saw features a 1.5mm heat-treated carbon steel blade, with 7 double-ground teeth per inch for strong, coarse cuts. The comfortable soft-grip TPR handle provides secure control and reduced user fatigue during demanding tasks.
